acceptance_criteria: CRC path is either evidenced from the available environment or reported as a concrete blocker.
Automated tests and state wording agree with demonstrated evidence.
No device contact or credential exposure occurs.

baseline.sequencing: B1-1 closure precedes B1-1M and B1-2.

invariants: No raw vendor responses or secrets persisted.
report.merge_gate: PO review of evidence; no merge on automated tests alone for CRC-dependent claims.
report.objective: Close the B1-1 CRC validation evidence gap with the smallest safe repository changes and a precise real-environment validation report.
output_contract: Validation report or minimal evidence/state patch
requirements: Read the cold-start files in order and use the existing graphify graph first.
Keep CRC as the local validation path and Docker/Podman optional only.
Never claim real CRC evidence unless actually observed.
risks: The worker environment may not have access to the user's CRC/oc shell.
Do not convert unavailable evidence into success.
validation_plan: Report real-environment evidence separately from automated validation.
